name: @fromcode119/typescript-multiple-inheritance
description: Extends TypeScript's type system for real OOP — multiple inheritance for classes, so a data shape never has to stay an interface. Zero runtime dependencies; standalone like react-class-components/next-build-codegen.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/build.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --external:typescript --outfile=dist/build.cjs && esbuild src/cli/tsmi-cli.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --external:typescript --external:esbuild --outfile=dist/tsmi-cli.cjs
